exact: amino acid adenylation by nonribosomal peptide synthase

definition: Activation of an amino acid for incorporation into a peptide by a nonribosomal process, catalyzed by subunits of nonribosomal peptide synthase. The amino acid is adenylated at its carboxylate group (ATP-dependent) then transferred to the thiol group of an enzyme-bound phosphopantetheine cofactor.
label: amino acid adenylylation by nonribosomal peptide synthase
